listing.name: Medal of Honor: Frontline — MOHFrontline-GC-RECOMP (ant0-blase)
listing.summary: Experimental project. The project describes an experimental native Linux Frontline player with enhanced rendering. Optional PS3 assets change presentation; they do not turn it into the PS3 game or establish PS3 executable compatibility. Portcove has not compared gameplay. See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own GameCube USA GMFE69; optional separately owned PS3 textures/fonts.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Follow the README’s GameCube source-build and native launcher instructions using your own GMFE69 game data. Optional PS3 remaster data requires your own PS3_FILES tree or finalized retail PKG; PS3 assets are not included.

warnings: The project describes an experimental native Linux Frontline player with enhanced rendering. Optional PS3 assets change presentation; they do not turn it into the PS3 game or establish PS3 executable compatibility. Portcove has not compared gameplay.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
